source.title: 十七层平面布置图
source.printedScale: label only; scale from the 59000 dimension line

meta.extraction: vector (PyMuPDF page.get_drawings(), OCG layers); text via page.get_text("words"); no raster tracing
meta.worldFrame: metres; x = east, z = south (+z south, -z north), y = up; origin = centre of the site.pdf 22F tower rectangle (site page pt 1620.077, 762.686; 8.306 pt/m), same as src/scene/scale.ts pageToWorld()

scale.method: overall top dimension 59000 mm between extension lines of axes a-1 and a-9 (layer G-GRID-DIMS)

transform.formula: x = px / pt_per_m + tx ; z = py / pt_per_m + tz  (px, py = PDF page pt, y down)
transform.fit: least-squares translation on 23 columns matched to F13.json columns (same CAD page frame as 13F); F13 is registered to site.pdf

deskRule.rule: D046/D060: desk centre to column edge >= 1.10 m and desk bbox not intersecting columns
deskRule.note: desks kept exactly as drawn; violations are deviations, not moved

walls.method: wall/glass/partition lines rasterised on a 0.1 m grid; a cell is changed if no cell of the other floor lies within 0.1 m; changes clustered (0.6 m), clusters < 1.0 m of line dropped

outline.method: 13F outline edges sampled at t=0.2..0.8, median distance to this sheet's facade layers BP-5~22F$0$A-OVLK, BP-5~22F$0$BP-5~22F$0$A-OVLK, BP-5~22F$0$A-WIND, BP-5~22F$0$BP-5~22F$0$A-WIND, BP-5~22F$0$A-WALL-FNSH, BP-5~22F$0$BP-5~22F$0$A-WALL-FNSH

knownIssues: Registration: this sheet uses the same CAD page frame as 13F (top 59000 dimension extension lines differ by 0.00 pt); translation fitted on 23 columns matched to F13.json (13F is registered to site.pdf).
Room polygons are axis-aligned ray-cast rectangles; polygon=null for: 1#卫, 1#楼梯, 2#楼梯, 5#电梯, 主管办公室, 卫排, 国际市场部（192+4人）, 备用间, 外廊, 多功能室, 女卫, 文档室, 母婴, 油烟, 男卫, 茶水, 观景平台.
Desk label(s) on sheet: 国际市场部（192+4人）. Extracted 192 desk rectangles (0.7x1.8: 192).
elevation_m uses the scene formula 6 + (n-2)*4.2 = 69.0; see meta.levelFromDrawing and README section 标高.
Includes a small COLUMN-layer pier C5 0.303x0.9 m at (-29.20,-9.10) (west core edge, not on 13F.pdf).
Level: no absolute level on this sheet, so meta.levelFromDrawing = null; meta.levelExtrapolated 73.45 / 73.4(结) is an extrapolation from 8F (+4.2 m per storey), 4.45 m above the scene elevation 69.0.
meta.levelNote: No absolute level on this sheet (re-checked all text: only the relative notes 楼层标高减50 / 楼层标高减100(结) (local areas 50 mm below finished / 100 mm below structural floor level); no level symbol at the tower west core lobby where 2F-8F carry theirs).

levelExtrapolated.basis: NOT on a drawing: 8F 35.650 / 35.600(结) + 4.200 m per storey (the 4F-8F tower interval, identical for 4 storeys)
